limitations: M25-0064-F01 — Reindexing adds a relation to a stratum instead of restricting the stratum, duplicating leading contributions — Counterevidence: Exact Fourier expansion and Proposition 5.8 statement not refuted. Deduplicating target strata would alter the displayed index convention. Correctly restricting original strata gives claimed estimate.

M25-0064-F02 — Multiplicity-counting auxiliary function does not satisfy the quoted divisor bound — Counterevidence: A broader multiplicative-function theorem might yield the desired estimate, but its hypotheses are not the bound as quoted. Replacing h with b(n)2^omega1(n), with omega1 distinct-prime count, restores all stated hypotheses.
